thread:
emma_sales: Quick heads-up — MzanziHealth just confirmed a 2-day pilot starting tomorrow in ZA, expecting bursts of inference traffic. Need a temporary capacity bump in af-south-1.

vivek_cs: How big is the expected qps? any SLA asks?

emma_sales: They want <100ms P95 for critical routes, roughly 250 concurrent sessions initially, bursty. They'll sign a month of Dedicated if we can guarantee no queueing during pilot.

maria_sre: Current admission control in af-south-1 is kicking in. We have `max_concurrent_per_customer=20` and global pool 80 gpus. With existing tenants we hit backpressure and requests are queuing ~30s.

james_infra: Can we do a short override to raise per-customer concurrency to 40 and allow 16 extra burst GPUs for 48h? That should reduce queueing without changing autoscale.

oncall-bot: Incident check: af-south-1 GPU utilization at node-pool level = 94% over last 15m; queue depth metric `inference_queue_len`=142.

vivek_cs: Customer is ok with a paid short-term bump. Sales proposes cost share: $1,500/day for the extra capacity. Need approvals.

maria_sre: Two concerns: 1) network egress on that region is peaky — we could see downstream throttles. 2) raising concurrency could increase latency for others if we don't reserve capacity. Suggest we instead create a temporary reservation (burst slice) of 16 GPUs for MzanziHealth and leave admission_control unchanged.

james_infra: I can provision the reservation via admin console, but need a ticket/override ID and owner. What values do we need?

emma_sales: Put me as owner. Override length: 48h starting 2026-03-19 08:00 UTC. Region: af-south-1. Resource: gpu.quota_extra=16. Billing code: SALES-MZ-987.

maria_sre: Ok runbook for rollback: revoke reservation at end time, validate `inference_queue_len` back to <10, and watch tailing error rate. I'll monitor and stand by.

james_infra: Creating the reservation now. Command I ran:```sh
# create transient reservation
redwood-admin reservations create --region af-south-1 --gpus 16 --owner emma_sales --expires 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z --notes "MzanziHealth pilot"
```

oncall-bot: Reservation created: res_za_5462, applied to cluster af-south-1-east.

vivek_cs: Thank you. Sales will send contract addendum and confirm billing. Please DM if any hiccups. :pray:

maria_sre: Monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/obs/af-south-1/reservations/res_za_5462 — I'll post updates there.

emma_sales: Appreciate everyone moving fast. If we need to extend beyond 48h we'll escalate to capacity-product for a sustained commit.

james_infra: Post-check after 10m: `inference_queue_len` dropped from 142 -> 8, P95 latency for the route is 86ms. Looks good so far.

maria_sre: I'll keep an eye and will alert if anything crosses thresholds. :thumbsup:

vivek_cs: Closing here for now, will reopen if customer reports any issues.

emma_sales: Closing — will update when pilot ends.
